_doc: Rest Frame (the everyday-physics channel): 'daylight lab', the only light-background channel. Read by kits/cinema/film/page.mjs (tokens → --<name>, roles → --hud-<role>, fonts → @font-face, type → --font-<role>, safe, captionY, cssText) and by kits/cinema/sci/contrast.py. Hexes are the bible's (films/channels/physics/bible.md §2); 'bg' and 'text' are aliases of 'cyc' and 'ink' for the page. Every hud.js default is dark-on-light inverted here: light plates, ink text, the spoken word on a marker band. Sizes are px at 1080×1920; the roles carry the same sizes in vmin (px / 10.8). Not Lumevina, not Los Güeros, not Claude coral: contrast.py checks the distances.
name: Rest Frame
promise: Everyday things, slowed down until the physics shows.

scene._doc: 3D only. The cyc's unlit shader outputs ACES-inverse values so it lands exactly on cyc / cyc-hi (cross-check: about 1.0 and 1.6 scene luminance); bloom threshold 2.5 or more; prop albedo 0.7 or below. Soft key from above-front-left, hemisphere fill, a cool rim from behind; no shadow maps. Ghosts are opaque, tinted toward the cyc. Approve on T2 stills first.

highlight._doc: A marker (highlighter) band behind the word being spoken; the word stays ink. Words still to come are ink-2.

type._doc: Display: Archivo ExtraBold Expanded (wght 800, wdth 125; set in cssText). The title card squashes the width axis on each contact. Text: IBM Plex Sans 700 captions, 600 labels (the variable file, wght 100–700, wdth 85–100). Counters, stopwatch and 'measure it' readouts: IBM Plex Mono (variable, wght 100–700). Plex figures are tabular by default. 'Plex' is a Reserved Font Name: the files ship unmodified.

sizes._doc: px at 1080×1920. Captions: at most 2 lines of at most 24 characters (kits/cinema/script pages them with max_chars = 24); the size is the largest whole px at which the widest of the 142 rows of all three episode-1 scripts (paged at 24 characters) fits the plate's maximum width, 0.72 × W = 778 px, without hud.js shrinking it. Measured in Chromium with this face on 2026-10-22: it fits up to 55.5 px; at 55 px the widest row ('balls down the same way.') makes a 769 px plate. The bible's 60–64 px was set before the 24-character rule. Labels: the pill is at least 0.035 × H = 67 px tall.

labels._doc: The pill always names the quantity, so colour is never the only cue. Physics labels use the bar mark (a thick coloured left edge) on light tags; the colour is also the leader line and the arrows.

contrast._doc: What contrast.py checks besides the automatic pairs. grounds: the flat colours text can sit on. behind: what the plate, pills and badges can sit over (worst case first: black, then the darkest token).

pairs.note: the spoken word on its marker band
the title's accent word on the cyc
label colours as text on a tag (bible: 4.9–7.9)
the apps' own white UI over the shade falloff (bottom 480 px, right 140 px)

motif.signature_shape: The strobe ladder: each key motion is stamped as opaque ghost copies at equal time steps (τk = τ0 + kΔ) on the ruled backdrop; rungs join ghosts of the same k. Speeding up shows as widening gaps you can measure.
motif.honesty_badges: Plex Mono badges for every simplification: 'slowed ×20', 'air ignored (under 1 ms here)', 'illustration'.
motif.title_card: 'The drop': the title falls onto a ruler line over the payoff image (y 250–470) and bounces twice on the sonic signature; Archivo's width axis squashes the letters on each contact, and three faint copies trail above it.
motif.end_card: 'Next drop: …' on the ruler line, then 'Follow Rest Frame'. Held ≥ 1.5 s.
motif.recurring_segment: A 'measure it' beat on the strobe ladder, with Plex Mono readouts (gaps, times, speeds).
motif.scale_readout: Ruler ticks on the grid (body uses the iris and a pill, space the light-time readout).
motif.colour_rules: Cobalt is force and the title's accent word; marker is only the band behind the spoken word. The strobe never flashes: fewer than 3 bright events a second.
motif.sound: G mixolydian at 112.5 BPM (a 16th is 4 frames); staccato blips instead of the felt piano; hard, close foley; signature knocks D6, B5, G5 at 0, +12, +20 frames (a ball bouncing to rest).
